name: Michigan
title: Michigan Rebate Calculator 2026: DTE, Consumers, Lansing BWL and Ann Arbor Rebates
h1: Michigan Rebate Calculator 2026: What Your City and Utility Pay
desc: Free Michigan rebate calculator for Detroit, Grand Rapids, Ann Arbor and Lansing. Heat pump, furnace, insulation, water heater and thermostat rebates, with the official source for every amount.
intro: Michigan rebates depend on your city and your utility. Pick your city and what heats your home, and this calculator shows what is open today.
short: Michigan has no single statewide utility rebate. Ann Arbor pays $4,000 for a heat pump. Lansing's Board of Water and Light pays $4,000 to $5,000 when a heat pump replaces a gas furnace. DTE pays $100 to $400 for a gas furnace and up to $600 for attic insulation. Consumers Energy pays $100 to $300 for a furnace and up to $475 for insulation. The state's MiHER rebates are paused for new income-qualified applications in five districts, and the federal tax credits ended after 2025.
faq: Is there a heat pump rebate in Michigan?

Only locally. Ann Arbor pays $4,000, or $5,500 for lower incomes. Lansing's Board of Water and Light pays $4,000 to $5,000 for a heat pump that replaces a gas furnace. DTE pays $150 to $1,200 for electric customers replacing electric heat. Consumers Energy pays $200 to $350 for replacements only.
Why is my total small for a gas home?
Most Michigan rebates for gas homes are for furnaces and insulation, not heat pumps. A gas home that switches to a heat pump usually gets no utility heat pump rebate, except in Ann Arbor and Lansing.
Is the state MiHER program open?
New income-qualified applications are paused in the Detroit, Warren, Grand Rapids, Lansing and Kalamazoo districts. Check the state page for updates.
Is the federal heat pump tax credit still available?
No. The 25C and 25D credits ended for work finished after December 31, 2025.

programs.name: Ann Arbor A2ZERO cold climate heat pump
programs.rules: Ann Arbor homes only. Cold climate model on the NEEP list, 15.2+ SEER2 and 8+ HSPF2. Reserve funds first. The rebate cannot exceed 90% of the cost.

programs.name: Ann Arbor A2ZERO heat pump water heater
programs.rules: Needs a UEF rating of 2.0 or higher and contractor installation.

programs.name: Ann Arbor A2ZERO insulation
programs.rules: Contractor installation. Air sealing needs blower door tests with at least 20% less leakage.

programs.name: DTE Energy heat pump
programs.rules: Only for DTE electric customers replacing electric heating. Funds are first come, first served.

programs.name: DTE Energy gas furnace
programs.rules: DTE gas customers. The $300 bonus is for qualified installs October 1 to December 15, 2026 and is not in the total.

programs.name: DTE Energy attic insulation
programs.rules: DTE gas customers, single-family home, 500 square feet or more. The $250 bonus needs a second measure and is not in the total.

programs.name: DTE Energy Wi-Fi thermostat
programs.rules: One per household. Apply within six months and by December 31, 2026.

programs.name: DTE Energy water heater instant discount
programs.rules: DTE's page lists no dollar amount, so it is not added to your total.

programs.name: Consumers Energy heat pump
programs.rules: Air source and ground source only replace an existing heat pump. A mini-split must replace a primary electric heat system.

programs.name: Consumers Energy gas furnace
programs.rules: $100 for 95% to 96.99% efficiency and $300 for 97% or better. Participating contractor.

programs.name: Consumers Energy insulation
programs.rules: Attic $125 to $200 by R-value, walls $125, basement walls and rim joist $50, for gas and combination customers. Deadline December 31.

programs.name: Consumers Energy Wi-Fi thermostat
programs.rules: Consumers' pages give different amounts, so it is not added to your total. Confirm before you buy.

programs.name: Lansing BWL heat pump replacing a gas furnace
programs.rules: $4,000 replacing a gas furnace and central air conditioner, $5,000 replacing a gas furnace only. Manual J report and pre-inspection required. BWL electric customers.

programs.name: Lansing BWL heat pump water heater
programs.rules: BWL's electrification page says $1,000 and its 2026 form says $500. The total counts $500. Confirm with BWL.

programs.name: Lansing BWL smart thermostat
programs.rules: One per account. Needs central air or electric heat.

programs.name: Lansing BWL insulation
programs.rules: Attic, wall or basement wall, with minimum R-values and area. Needs central air or electric heat.

notes: We have not verified DTE or Consumers water heater instant discount amounts, either company's income-qualified heat pump amounts, or rooftop solar rules. We list only what we have read on a program's own page.
Amounts are the most a program pays. Your rebate depends on the equipment, your account type and your final invoice. Bonuses with a date window are listed but not added to the total.
